legend: You are given an integer $N$. Print a centred pyramid of stars with $N$ rows: row $i$ has $N - i$ spaces followed by $2i - 1$ stars.
input: One line with an integer $N$ ($1 \le N \le 99$).
output: Print the pyramid, as in the example.
notes: Do not print spaces after the last \texttt{*} of a line.
